The Draconid meteor shower peaks on Friday 9 October and is best just after dark. No telescope. Just a coat.

It plays in the UK, who made it, how long it runs, what's in it. These channels are new to us, so they had our shorter check, not the full panel. Your judgement about your child matters more than ours.
